name: Integrated EW
desc:
This ship is equipped with advanced electronic warfare measures that reduces the chance for missiles launched by the ship to be affected by electronic counter-measures and flares by %s.

Each missile also receives a significantly improved guidance algorithm, as well increased top speed of %s and maneuverability of %s.

Enemy ECM range reduction is also reduced by %s. When deployed, the ship also grants %s/%s/%s/%s ECM rating, depending on this ship's hull size.
short: Improves missile speed and guidance, reduces effect of enemy Electronic Warfare and increases ship ECM rating.
sModDesc: Fully negates the weapon range reduction, and makes the ship's missiles always ignore flares.

name: AEGIS Combat System
desc:
This ship is equipped with the AEGIS Combat System, which allows point defense to identify - and ignore - decoy flares. In addition, all point-defense weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness, and all damage to missiles is increased by %s.  

Missiles launched by the ship are less likely to be affected by electronic counter-measures and flares by %s.

Each missile also receives a significantly improved guidance algorithm, as well increased top speed of %s and maneuverability of %s.

Enemy ECM range reduction is also reduced by %s. When deployed, the ship also grants %s/%s/%s/%s ECM rating, depending on this ship's hull size.
short: Improves PD, missile speed and guidance, reduces effect of enemy EW and increases ship ECM rating.
sModDesc:
Fully negates the weapon range reduction, and makes the ship's missiles always ignore flares. 

All small non-missile, non-strike weapons are classified as "point-defense", automatically target missiles, and are affected by point-defense stat modifiers.
